prompt:
Please add the June 30 covenant-headroom slide to the current lender-update deck.

Please work in `Shared/Finance/Treasury/Bank - covenants/2026 Q2 working/Q2 lender update - review working v3.pptx` and save the finished file back there.

Preserve the five existing slides' substantive content and order and append one final slide titled `Q2 covenant headroom - posted vs pro forma`. Add a real PowerPoint table with rows for Leverage, FCCR, and Tangible Net Worth and columns for Posted, Pro Forma, Threshold, and Status. Harmless formatting normalization on the existing slides is not material. Use `Q2 covenant headroom - lender review working.xlsx` as the calculation scaffold and the executed agreement as the legal authority. For the pro-forma basis, use the Controller's proposed and unposted June WIP revenue adjustment of $1,276,325.70 as the sole pro-forma change: add it to LTM adjusted EBITDA and tangible net worth while leaving funded debt and fixed charges unchanged. Do not substitute gross contract assets or another WIP population total. For FCCR, use zero cash taxes because the released ledger contains no identifiable income-tax cash-payment population; calculate unfunded capex as LTM fixed-asset additions less direct LTM equipment-financing proceeds; use cash interest from account 7100 and scheduled principal from LTM posted CD principal lines. For tangible net worth, sign trial-balance accounts by normal balance so allowance and accumulated-depreciation contra-assets reduce assets. Add Posted Headroom and Pro Forma Headroom columns: for leverage and FCCR, show the adjusted-EBITDA decline that would cause a breach; for tangible net worth, show the remaining dollar cushion. Identify the binding covenant on the like-for-like adjusted-EBITDA-deterioration basis. Show the source-supported result for each basis; normal status wording such as compliant, passes, within threshold, or no breach is acceptable. Include a compact source note identifying the working scaffold, executed amendment, June 30 debt support, posted accounting basis, and proposed-WIP support. Match the deck's existing visual system.

Add a compact calculation-support block on the slide so the covenant results can be reperformed without relying on the displayed ratios alone. Show funded debt, posted and pro-forma adjusted EBITDA, cash taxes, LTM fixed-asset additions, direct LTM equipment financing, unfunded capex, cash interest, scheduled principal, fixed charges, and the posted and pro-forma FCCR numerators. Show the arithmetic for the EBITDA bridge, unfunded capex, fixed charges, and both FCCR numerators.

Add a compact downside sensitivity for 25%, 50%, and 100% reversal of the proposed $1,276,325.70 WIP adjustment from the full pro-forma case. For each reversal, show the retained WIP adjustment, adjusted EBITDA, tangible net worth, leverage, FCCR numerator, FCCR, leverage and FCCR adjusted-EBITDA deterioration capacity, tangible-net-worth headroom, and compliance status. Keep funded debt, fixed charges, cash taxes, and unfunded capex unchanged across the sensitivity, and label it as an illustrative lender-review sensitivity rather than a posted or submitted covenant basis.

Use the executed agreement, current debt support, posted accounting data, and proposed-WIP evidence chain for the June covenant slide. Do not copy the prior-quarter submitted slide or the superseded covenant summary. Do not add any other slides and do not represent the deck as submitted. Save to the same path.

Leave only the finished file in the shared company workspace, with no draft scripts or temporary exports.
title: Append one Q2 covenant-headroom slide
